Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical factual error in its initial analysis of the WebSurfer's first search results. It incorrectly interpreted a snippet mentioning "Most wins: Muhammad Ali (3)" as evidence that Muhammad Ali won the main BBC Sports Personality of the Year award. In reality, Muhammad Ali won the *Overseas* Sports Personality of the Year award, not the main award. This misinterpretation led the Planner to pursue an incorrect line of reasoning (identifying Muhammad Ali's brother) instead of correctly identifying the record holder for the main award (Andy Murray). This error persisted through multiple steps, causing the entire conversation to cycle around the wrong subject.
